node.name: QueryService only knows the LlmClient interface; at run time it is GemmaClient, which calls Gemma 4 (vLLM, OpenAI-compatible API) with a time limit. A text query has no image embedding: retrieve() scores keywords and attributes, and VectorIndex.nearest() is not called. SearchUI shows the results with SearchResultView.render(results).

node.name: WebServer takes customerId from the session (SessionManager), never from the page. It answers NoSuchElementException with 404 and IllegalStateException with 409; after a cancel it returns OrderController.viewOrder(customerId, orderId), the order with its new status.
